description: For jobsite safety, this estimate request form records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

title: Jobsite Safety Estimate Request Form
use_case: Use the estimate request form during jobsite hazard assessment and control verification when the jobsite safety record must identify work zone, crew, task sequence, tools, mobile equipment, utilities, and public interfaces. Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
